[[File:Fanlanden map.jpg|140px|left|link=The Banner-lands]]
'''[[The Banner-lands]]''' are the known world: one kidney-shaped continent against [[the Sleeping Sea]], walled by [[the Silent Mountains]], with [[the Ash Fields]] at its heart. The rivers are deliberately unnamed on every chart — ''draw the water, omit the quarrel'' — and the continent itself is named for a miscount: eleven banners, where the record counts ten.
